title: First Job Desk: mock interview, offer letter decoder, first 180 days
description: Free tools for your first job. Practise a mock interview and read the interviewer's notes on your answers, see your monthly in-hand pay from your offer letter, and find out how to handle common situations in your first six months at work.
target_audience: Final-year students and new graduates preparing for or starting their first job
questions_it_answers: How do I prepare for a job interview?
How do I get my first job?
How do I answer tell me about yourself?
What is the difference between CTC and in-hand salary?
What does a bond in an offer letter mean?
What should I do in my first week at work?
How do I talk to my manager?
What should I do if I miss a deadline?
Should I resign from my first job?
How do I handle my probation review?
